entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH (SACHIN MITTAL VS. STATE OF M.P.) Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri C.P.Singh,
learned counsel for the State.
This first application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for grant of anticipatory bail.

The applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.383/2019 registered at Police Station Ambah, District Morena for offence under Sections 420, 272, 273 and 120-B of I.P.C. r/w Section 51 and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
After arguing the matter at length, the counsel for the applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this application.
Accordingly, the application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(G.S. Ahluwalia)
